statement: Boundary-tame covers specialize to the strict log fibre over any complete mixed-characteristic trait; all existing proper integral log-regular models give the same tame category and framed tame arithmetic extension
depends_on: HoshiLog2009A567 Cor3.9 and PropA.10;properness and divisorial log structures
notes: No mixed-characteristic resolution or common regular refinement assumed. The arithmetic quotient is G_F^t; the geometric kernel is not identified with the full geometric group.

statement: All finite etale covers cannot replace boundary-tame covers in mixed-characteristic logarithmic specialization
notes: The constant Q2(sqrt2) cover of P1_Q2 minus 0 1 infinity is finite etale and wild with e=2 along the vertical divisor of the proper regular SNC model.

statement: The node-inertia character is cyclotomic times the branch-interchange sign; automatic cyclotomic action without split branches is false
notes: Explicit one-pointed rational nodal cubic y^2=x^2(x-1); branches at +/-i; Galois-invariant nonzero tensor; complex conjugation acts as +1 on node inertia.

statement: The strict characteristic-zero Isom-anabelian definition is not preserved unchanged by arithmetic specialization
notes: Nonisomorphic unlabelled four-punctured lines over F16 have augmented groups identified by relative Frobenius; both lift over Q(zeta15). Exact finite certificate checks all six cross-ratio values and the field data.
